name: Shadow Hand finger (rigid, tendon-driven -- kinematic reference)

source.detail: kinematic reference -- forward kinematics from published nominal Shadow Dexterous Hand dimensions (45/25/26 mm phalanges); not FEM

metadata.notes: Rigid articulated finger: 3 revolute joints (MCP 80 deg, PIP 100 deg, DIP 70 deg max flex; J1/J2 tendon-coupled gives ~3 independent DOF). Placed from forward kinematics as a reference point for the soft-actuator map -- the rigid limit a continuum design would converge toward if coarsened. Qualitative force: high (rigid tendon), no numeric value.

input.energy_convention: mechanical work delivered at the input port (J)
